targets.name: Shackleton Connecting Ridge
targets.description: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache craters at the lunar south pole. A representative site for a future Moon base, not a declared base location and not an Artemis III region. No feature here captures the low sun or permanent shadow that define the pole.
targets.coordinate_note: Coordinates to confirm against a published source. Diviner shows a sunlit site here (annual maximum about 248 K), which fits a ridge.

slope.note: LOLA LDEM_60S_240MPP averaged to 480 m. Mean over a 28 km window, which includes the Shackleton crater wall.

roughness.note: LOLA at 480 m, 3 x 3 window, mean over 28 km.

temp_annual_range.note: Lower bound: Diviner annual maximum minus annual mean, within 3 km. The true range is larger, and the Earth scale clamps it either way.

temp_diurnal_range.note: Not measured yet. Needs the Diviner seasonal polar tables (PCP, over 200 MB per file) or organizer data. Missing on purpose: it lowers confidence and is left out of the score.

mean_temperature.note: Diviner annual mean of 135.0 K within 3 km, from thermal model fits to observations.

composition.note: Proposed handling from the spec: anorthositic highlands mapped to felsic, the nearest available class. A citation is still needed, and the site sheet must show this limit.

elevation.note: Relative to the lunar reference radius. Context only.

targets.name: Arcadia Planitia
targets.description: Northern plain with shallow water ice. NASA JPL calls it the most tempting target in the northern hemisphere. The coordinates are a representative point in the plain, not a selected landing site.
targets.coordinate_note: Representative point chosen for this prototype. The team should confirm it.

slope.note: MOLA at 463 m. Mean over a 28 km window.

roughness.note: MOLA at 463 m, 3 x 3 window, mean over 28 km.

temp_annual_range.note: Mars Climate Database v6.2 surface temperature: warmest minus coldest seasonal daily mean. A model, so basis is literature.

temp_diurnal_range.note: Mars Climate Database v6.2: 13:30 minus 01:30 local time, mirroring the MODIS overpass, averaged over the year.

mean_temperature.note: Mars Climate Database v6.2 mean surface temperature.

composition.note: Described as volcanic flows in general sources. Basaltic is inferred, not confirmed by a peer-reviewed study. Replace this source.

elevation.note: Relative to the Mars datum. Context only.

targets.name: Jezero crater
targets.description: Crater with an ancient river delta, where Perseverance landed in 2021 at Octavia E. Butler Landing. It is not a future site. It stays as a well-studied reference that anchors the demo.
targets.coordinate_note: Coordinates of Octavia E. Butler Landing.

slope.note: MOLA at 463 m. Mean over a 28 km window.

roughness.note: MOLA at 463 m, 3 x 3 window, mean over 28 km.

temp_annual_range.note: Mars Climate Database v6.2 surface temperature: warmest minus coldest seasonal daily mean. A model, so basis is literature. MEDA rover data could replace it.

temp_diurnal_range.note: Mars Climate Database v6.2: 13:30 minus 01:30 local time, mirroring the MODIS overpass, averaged over the year.

mean_temperature.note: Mars Climate Database v6.2 mean surface temperature.

composition.note: Farley et al. 2022 describe igneous crater floor rocks: olivine-rich Seitah under Maaz, read as lava flows. Mapped to basaltic by the team; the delta is sedimentary.

elevation.note: Relative to the Mars datum. Context only.
